answer: Why do clone farms stay cheap? Because identity is free to mint. Signed shipping agent record with maritime agency attestation changes that arithmetic: agency work the agency recorded across years of vessels, so the gale for each fake is paid in the real world. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the oasis is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the hollow of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
